action.description: plan evaluates the safety checks without changing anything. execute starts restoring the source DB instance to a new instance; call again with the same parameters to see its state and endpoint. The source instance is never changed.

dbInstanceIdentifier.description: Identifier of the RDS DB instance to restore. Aurora DB instances aren't supported.

targetDbInstanceIdentifier.description: Identifier of the new DB instance to restore into, in the same region and account. It must not exist yet.

restorePointInTime.description: RFC 3339 time to restore to, between the source's earliest and latest restorable times (reported by plan).
